result:
**Verdict: PASS** for DG2 round 11 (T-DG2-REV-DOM-R11), with no new findings. The F-DG2-420 to 429 ids are unused, and I wrote no findings or verifications file.

**Candidate.** HEAD is the freeze commit `309aff2c`, which sits on source commit `cbdb4f68` and changes only delivery records. I recomputed `sha256:23e6c0a2…7bad` (547 files) in the repository and in a disposable clone, before and after the runs, and it matched. The DG1 historical validation passes.

**The fix (D-071 / BE16) doesn't touch the domain.** It changes only how the API handles connections. Nothing under `apps/web`, `packages` or `docs/source` changed, so no playbook text, gate rule, register column, translation or screen is affected. On a live stack:
- **Normal evidence file:** a 2 MiB file with an Arabic file name uploads with 200 and the connection stays open. It downloads byte-for-byte identical.
- **Oversized file:** a 26 MiB upload is refused with the declared 413 `evidence.too_large`, with matching English and Arabic messages. The server closes the connection about 1 ms after answering, instead of holding it for about 65 seconds. Nothing is stored, and a normal upload afterwards still works.
- **Other routes:** links straight to the Diagnose, Define and Design pages still load, and an unknown API address returns 404.

**Full re-review.** All 26 requirements match the playbook, checked against blocks B0009, B0018, B0023, B0029, B0035–B0043, B0050–B0051, B0056, B0058, B0062 and B0065.
- **Gates:** G1, G2 and G3 must be decided in order; skipping ahead is refused. I made live G1, G2 and G3 decisions on synthetic data.
- **Text input:** Arabic charter text with right-to-left marks is stored exactly as entered. Text that is only invisible characters is refused with the right message in English and Arabic.
- **Screens:** Arabic pages render right-to-left and English left-to-right.
- **Invariants:** unknown values show as Unknown, never zero or green; money uses decimal columns. The brand is marked provisional. Nothing claims PMI or Mobily certification, and product gates G1–G6 never reference DG0–DG7.

**Checks run:**

| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| Typecheck, build and lint | exit 0 on Node 22 and Node 24 |
| `pnpm test` | 771 of 771 pass on both versions |
| Contrast check | PASS on both versions |
| Live API checks (disposable database and API) | 208 pass, 0 fail |
| Live browser checks, English and Arabic (second fresh stack) | 66 pass, 0 fail |

The browser count excludes one probe that only prints observations: it confirms the B0009 mode guidance text appears verbatim.

**Warnings in the logs.** Every warning or non-zero line is explained in the record:
- The install prints two "failed to create bin" warnings because that file exists only after the build.
- The build prints a bundle-size advisory.
- The contrast tool lists three colour pairs that are documented as must-fail examples.
- The unit tests print one Fastify deprecation notice; the tests in that file pass.
- The database probe that exits 1 does so on purpose: it checks that a non-UTF8 database is refused.
- One expected-text label in my own probe says "201" where the actual check reads the follow-up request, which returns 200.

**Not a finding (Low, observation only).** On a new transformation, G3 shows "1 of 5 mandatory outputs complete". The one counted as complete is "every open design decision has an owner", which is trivially true when there are no decisions. The gate stays red and incomplete, so this isn't a false green.

**Not checked live (environment limits, not gate checks):** live registry (D-057), live CI (D-058) and Keycloak (D-049). I checked their offline configuration only.

**Handback location.** The write guard refused the assigned path `docs/delivery/handbacks/DG2/…` for my role. As in round 10, the handback is in my evidence folder, and you may want to move it.

The disposable clone and all scratch files have been removed, and no stack processes are left running.

Files are in `docs/delivery/`:
- reviews/DG2/round-11/domain-reviewer.json
- reviews/DG2/round-11/domain-reviewer.md
- test-evidence/DG2/domain/round-11/handback-T-DG2-REV-DOM-R11-domain-reviewer.md
